description: Only for clients that can perform an HTTP PUT or multipart POST (not chat-only clients such as Gemini): if you cannot make that request yourself, use autoposter_create_upload_link instead. Generates a presigned S3 upload URL for direct, high-speed upload of videos or images up to 5GB without size limits or timeouts. Returns direct PUT url, POST upload fields, and public CDN URL.

fileName.description: Name of the file including extension (e.g. 'promo_video.mp4', 'photo.jpg').

name: autoposter_get_media_upload_url

directPutUrl.description: Presigned S3 PUT URL for direct upload.

instructions.description: Instructions for completing the direct upload.

key.description: S3 object key for the media file.

success.description: Whether the upload URL was successfully created.

uploadPost.description: Presigned POST fields if using multipart upload.

title: Get Direct S3 Upload URL
